title: AlmaLinux OS 9 must have the nss-tools package installed.
check_content:
Verify that AlmaLinux OS 9 has the nss-tools package installed with the following command:

$ dnf list --installed nss-tools

Installed Packages
nss-tools.x86_64       3.90.0-6.el9_2.tuxcare.1                @@commandline

If the "nss-tools" package is not installed, this is a finding.
fixtext:
The nss-tools package can be installed with the following command:
 
$ dnf install nss-tools
VulnDiscussion: Network Security Services (NSS) is a set of libraries designed to support cross-platform development of security-enabled client and server applications. Install the "nss-tools" package to install command-line tools to manipulate the NSS certificate and key database.
